svg.aria-label: Maarib's desk, a busy wooden table seen from above. About, as an open Canadian passport. The visa page is covered edge to edge in entry and exit stamps: Pakistan (Karachi, Lahore), Canada (Toronto, Vancouver), the Dominican Republic, the United States (New York, Los Angeles), the United Kingdom, France, Mexico, Turkey and Dubai. The data page, under a Canada wordmark: a colour pixel portrait of Maarib that blinks every few seconds: dark swept-back hair faded at the sides and a full textured beard. Name: Maarib Shah. Occupation: product designer. Level: 12+ years. Base: Toronto. Worlds: Fintech, DeFi. Issued 17 Oct 2011. Signed Maarib Shah. Around it: part of a keyboard, a mug of coffee, two Metallica tickets with a house key below them, a boarding pass from YYZ to anywhere, and a pencil. Range, as three manila folders. Fintech: Glow Finance, Megprime Pay, Concrete Finance, Credit Coop, Polymarket. Web3: XMTP, Koop, The Wall Street Journal, DC Pictures. Commerce: Shop Bonsai, Suntory, Zala Hair, Complex. On and around them, with a dog sticker by the label: a stapler, a pack of cigarettes, two highlighters, a cigarette resting in a glass ashtray, a cat sticker and balls of scrap paper. Stack, as pixel-art logo stickers on a green cutting mat: Figma, Framer, Claude, Cursor, GitHub, React, Next.js, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, ChatGPT, Miro, Maze, Notion and VS Code look new; Sketch, Photoshop, Illustrator, XD, Jira, Confluence and UserTesting are older, faded and peeling. Below it: two markers, an eraser and a floppy disk. A newspaper open at the classifieds. Wanted: Hard problems in fintech and DeFi. Will design, prototype and ship. Found: Black cat. Answers to “the boss”. Will not be returned. The wanted ad is circled in red pen. A tall weather box maps Ontario: Thunder Bay -47°, Sudbury -44°, Ottawa -41°, Toronto -38°. Beside it, a crossword half filled in (Figma across, Font down) and a Clip & save coupon for one free design review, partly cut out. A paperclip, a pencil and a scrambled Rubik's cube lie on the paper. A polaroid of the cat, captioned the boss, lies on its top edge; a floppy disk lies on a clipping headlined Extreme cold, and a cafe receipt, a todo note (fewer meetings, more cats, ship it) and a board game called Ship It! stick out from under the paper, next to a CD and a tape dispenser. Contact, as an orange envelope with a maple leaf stamp and a Toronto postmark, addressed to maarib@mail.com. Around it: an iPhone that wakes up to a You got mail! notification, a gamepad, a Magic 8 Ball, a tape player wired to a pair of black over-ear headphones and a tactical watch with its straps open. At the end, beside a sunset palm sticker, a retro camera with its strap, a plant, a cursor sticker and a GTA VI sticker, an iPad lying on the table shows a terminal window floating over a dusk wallpaper; it types whoami, Product designer who builds, then npm install maarib, which adds Figma, Claude Code, React, Next, Tailwind and coffee: added 312 packages, 1 cat. A black cat pops up and blinks.
